We're just two days away from a special LIVE taping of **Zeteo 's** flagship
'We're Not Kidding' podcast with **Mehdi Hasan** and acclaimed Palestinian-
American comedian and actor **Mo Amer.**

[ Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

The two are taking the stage this Friday at Houston's **Cullen Performance
Hall** for a night full of laughs and important political and social
commentary. Thanks to your enthusiastic response, this event is now **sold
out. BUT** there's still a chance for you to stream the conversation LIVE,
including an audience Q&A session with Mehdi and Mo.

PLUS, tune in for a special one-on-one conversation with Mehdi and Texas
**Rep. Greg Casar,** who will also be taking audience questions.

Events like this are made possible by your support, so we're thanking our
**paid subscribers** with **exclusive** access to the livestream:

[Click Here To Watch](https://open.substack.com/live-stream/409395)

If you're a free subscriber, [now's the perfect time to
upgrade](https://zeteo.com/subscribe) to watch the livestream, get early
access to future events, and never hit a paywall on any of Zeteo's award-
winning content ever again!
